title: The clone censuses key a window by its owning function: a rule written twice in one function is not a copy
claim: duplication_copies -- the score's heaviest metric (weight 8.93, counters.gapped_clones) and the ratchet's row (structure.duplicate_clones) -- counts a window only when two different functions own it, so a window written twice inside one function reads 0 in every one of the 95 package files, and folding two clone functions' bodies, both still written out, under one def reads IMPROVES.
mechanism: Both censuses file each window under `windows[digest].add((rel, fn.name, fn.lineno))` and form a class only from a digest with two or more owners. Two places of one function are one owner. Today's tree holds 6 such in-function copies under the ratchet's adjacent window (m1_ratchet_census.py COPY lines: climate.extra_state_attributes 4 places, thermal_model.simulate_trajectory_batch 4, optimizer._comfort_terms_batch 3, optimizer._analyze_forecast_trajectory 2, tariff._smooth_topk_sum 2, tariff._smooth_topk_sum_batch 2) and 15 under the score's gapped window (duplication_copies 18 -> 33 with the owner keyed by place), none priced. The same rule is a game: prototype `fold` moves ledger.add's and ledger.observe_meta_mean's bodies verbatim into the two branches of one `_fold`, shares nothing, and reads dS +0.6964 IMPROVES, admissible (duplication_copies 18 -> 17). No red-team attempt under tools/audit/archscore/planted/redteam/ plants it.

evidence.unit: holes_clone1: package files (of 95) in which a planted in-function copy is absent from the score's duplication_copies sites; the two-function control holes_clone2=0
evidence.contention_note: fan-out in progress, load1 about 289; static counts and a deterministic score

perturbation.change: --fold-owner: in memory, counters.gapped_clones' owner carries the window's place (two disjoint places of one function are two owners). holes_clone1 falls 95 -> 0 with every other plant kind still at 0 holes; the same switch on m7_prototypes.py --score --only fold takes the game's dS from +0.6964 to +0.0000.

metric_definition: Files (of the 95) whose planted window, written twice in ONE function, is missing from gapped_clones' classes. Key: the probe function's name in the census's own site list.
phenomenon_property: A statement window written at two disjoint places is a copy wherever the places are -- in two functions or in one -- in both the ratchet's clone census and the score's; merging the functions that hold two copies does not lower either count while both copies remain.

proposed_fix_scope: tests/structure.py duplicate_clones and tools/audit/archscore/counters.py gapped_clones: key a window's owner by place, so two disjoint places of one function form a class (overlapping windows of one run must not); one planted BAD case and one red-team attempt (the fold) with the counter's ablation; re-record duplication_copies with the reason (the ratchet's row rises by today's in-function copies) or pay them. The stored corpus vectors re-measure for duplication_copies.
